purpose: Bounded ARM64/QEMU resource and current-schema smoke; software evidence only, not physical Raspberry Pi acceptance.

platforms.app: linux/arm64 under Docker Desktop/QEMU on an amd64 macOS host
platforms.database: linux/amd64 PostGIS 16-3.4; database architecture was held native to keep migration replay bounded

schema_replay.optional_role_bootstrap: Applied the repository's idempotent bootstrap-optional-roles.sql to this disposable database before resuming at migration 427.

single_docker_stats_sample.note: One observation only; not a sustained workload benchmark or sizing guarantee.

limitations: No physical Raspberry Pi was available; QEMU does not measure device-specific performance, thermals, storage, power-loss, or peripheral behavior.
The PostgreSQL container was amd64, so this run is not an ARM64 database runtime test.
A single Docker stats sample does not establish sustained resource requirements or a profile-wide resource budget.
This was not a 24-hour recovery, provider outage, replica failover, or scale-concurrency test.
